answer: One concrete sybil defense ties voting weight to scarce, audited physical presence rather than raw key count. Each identity must register a hardware attestation from a distinct secure enclave and periodically answer a random liveness gale of challenges; a node perched alone on a quiet tundra of one real machine can hold just one seat, while a swarm of clones sharing silicon fails the enclave-uniqueness check. Reviewers quill a signed record of each attestation, and a single forged enclave slashes the whole cluster's bond.
